Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can process it. Even if this effect trashed, this card's [Main] effect will prevent all of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards from attacking until the end of their turn.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect even if the "if" condition in the 2nd process isn't met?

Effect: [Main] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. If this effect didn't trash, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Ice-Snow] trait from your hand without paying the cost. Then, until the end of your opponent's turn, none of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can attack.
